about_short_description.short_description: MobileMasr sells both new and used mobile phones, tablets, and a variety of related products.

product.name: MobileMasr Marketplace
product.description: An online marketplace for listing, comparing, buying, and selling new and used mobile devices and consumer electronics through private sellers and approved merchants.

product.name: New and Used Mobile Phones
product.description: New and pre-owned smartphones from brands such as Apple, Samsung, Xiaomi, OPPO, realme, Huawei, Honor, Motorola, Google, and others.

product.name: Tablets
product.description: New and used tablets from brands including Apple, Samsung, Huawei, Honor, Lenovo, Xiaomi, ZTE, and G-Tab, with Wi-Fi, 4G, 5G, and cellular variants.

product.name: Laptops
product.description: New and used laptops, including Apple MacBook, Lenovo, HP, Acer, and other models, with listings organized by processor, RAM, storage, graphics, display, and condition.

product.name: Smartwatches and Wearable Devices
product.description: New and used smartwatches and fitness bands from Apple, Samsung, Huawei, Xiaomi, Amazfit, and other brands, including GPS, cellular, and eSIM models.

product.name: Bluetooth Headphones and Earbuds
product.description: New and used wireless headphones and true-wireless earbuds from Apple, Samsung, Huawei, OnePlus, Soundcore, Jabra, and Beats.
